title: unit blueprint
description: A unit with {{ parameter }} places, filled from mirrorboard.toml. After filling it must be a valid unit file.

parameters.description: Every parameter this blueprint uses; mirrorboard.toml gives each one a value.

rooms.description: Rooms on the chain: registers (with a definition) and plain rooms such as agents' meta storage.

definition.description: A register's definition. Without it the room is a plain room, e.g. an agent's meta storage.

permissions.description: Who is a member of this room, and with which Actanet permissions (DATA_ROOM_PERM_*). An entry with only address reads only.

label.description: The unit's name as people read it.

blueprints.description: Blueprints of rooms made for agents created later.

parameters.description: The parameters the blueprint uses, filled at each agent's birth.

permissions.description: Who is a member of this room, and with which Actanet permissions (DATA_ROOM_PERM_*). An entry with only address reads only.

additionalProperties.description: A room made later, once for each agent that names it as meta. {{ agent }} is the address of that agent.

owner.description: The account that owns it: account://<key of the accounts file>. Always written out; nothing is owned by default.

position_definition.description: The position in a definition, e.g. definition+kancelaria://spec/positions/ksiegowosc/glowny_ksiegowy.

register_definition.description: The register in a definition, e.g. definition+kancelaria://spec/registers/depozyty.

agents.description: Agents. One nested under another is created by it later; one at the top is born at the deploy.

meta.description: Where the agent keeps its memory: room://<unit>/<room> for a standing agent, blueprint://<unit>/<blueprint> for one created later, whose room is made from the blueprint at its birth.

contacts.description: Who may wake this agent and give it work: an agent or account of this organization, or the agents of one position in a partner organization.

organization.description: A partner organization's account: account://<key of the accounts file>.

position.description: The partner's position whose agents may wake this one: definition+<id>://spec/positions/...

systems.description: The Systems this agent is announced in, so agents outside the organization can find and wake it.

notice.description: What the agent does, as others read it in the System.

visibility.description: public: everyone sees the notice; participants: only the System's participants.

wake.description: Who in the System may wake the agent.

manage_content.description: Change and delete entries, also others'.

grant_content.description: Give others access to chosen entries.

manage_permissions.description: Change members' permissions, within its own.

rotate_keys.description: Replace the room's key, e.g. after removing a member.
